messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Business Services and Partnerships" as it appears in the following examples.
['I want you to assist me transfer the money out from Senegal to your position so that you can help us to invest it', 'I inherited a substantial capital of five million four hundred and twenty thousand United States dollars (USDA 5,420 00000) from my late father which I honorably intend to invest in your country into a very lucrative business venture of which you are to advise and execute the said venture over there in your country for the mutual benefits of both of us.', 'We have agreed to give you %30 (thirty percent) of the total sum for your noble assistance, while the remaining will be for my family investment in your country or any country you may advise.', 'I need your urgent assistance in transferring the sum of $11.3 million immediately to your account.', 'These directions are to be e-mailed and followed by all users of the Business and Commercial Internet Cash Management.', 'These instructions are to be mailed and followed by all members of the Business and Commercial Online Treasury Services.', 'These directions are to be sent and followed by all users of the Business and Commercial Internet Cash Management.', 'You will acts my international business representative and also my family business associate, so that the bank will transfer this money to your account for safe keeping.', 'I am interested in a partnership investment program with yourself/corporation.', 'These instructions are to be sent and followed by all users of the Commercial Treasury Management.', 'I HAVE DECIDED TO CONTACT YOU ON A BUSINESS TRANSACTION THAT WILL BE VERY BENEFICIAL TO BOTH OF US AT THE END OF THE TRANSACTION.', 'I want you to help me claim and retrieved these fund from the Fiduciary Fund Holders and Transfer it into your personal account in your country for investment purposes on profitable ventures.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
